notes: Lead: Head of Product (Sara Patel), CTO (Anil Rao). Primary contact: Sara.
Primary workload: agentic support assistant that does multi-step tool calls: search -> fetch user data -> perform action (ticket update).
Latency SLO: front-end streaming p95 target ~250-400ms for perceived UX; backend tool-calls expected <= 800ms ideally, fallback within 1.5s.
Concern: if a tool call blocks or times out, the agent must gracefully fallback (partial reply + async follow-up). They called this 'no dead-agent' requirement.
Quote from CTO: 'If tool calls take >2s users abandon the flow. We need consistent sub-second perceived latency for agentic steps.'
Interested in: streaming + function/tool calling, structured outputs for action confirmation, deterministic fallback policies, idempotent action execution and dedupe for retries.
POC success criteria: 2-week test on Hosted API with simulated traffic; measure p95 streaming latency, tool-call success rate, and end-to-end task completion; cost estimate for Dedicated reserve.
They asked about Redwood's support for long-running tool calls (webhook callbacks) vs synchronous timeouts; want configurable timeouts and retry policy docs.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-market procurement; prefer predictable monthly commit for Dedicated if math shows unit-cost win over Hosted at >50k tokens/day.
Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, optional bring-your-own-KMS. Data residency required for EU subset of customers (future phase).
poc_plan: Week 0: baseline -> integrate Hosted API into staging UI (streaming + function-calls harness)
Week 1: simulate 500 concurrent users, capture p50/p95 streaming latency, tool-call latencies, success/failure modes
Week 2: run edge cases: flaky downstream tool (simulate timeouts), validate fallback flows and async callbacks, measure perceived UX impact
Deliverable: perf report + recommended Dedicated sizing and pricing model; go/no-go decision at end of week 2
use_case_details: Agentic customer support assistant for SMB customers: chat + tools. Typical flow: user asks billing question -> agent searches KB -> fetches account by account_id -> triggers billing action (refund/credit). Must ensure tool-call reliability (no duplicate refunds), stream partial answers during tool ops, and have fallback async notifications if action delayed.
